limitations: The sign-in email-code test requires development mailbox support; the production-mode scratch host intentionally has no Resend/Google credentials, so it exposes password sign-in and a provider-setup notice. No delivery was attempted or claimed.

The persisted-theme test uses signInFixture, documented as dev-only. The production proxy rejects this shortcut. Its built run does not test authenticated theme behavior; the same test passes under its intended development configuration.
The built mobile theme test can observe a cookie on an unauthenticated shell; do not count this as an authenticated production journey.
Actual Chrome with an existing real local session navigated marketing -> Features/Competition anchor -> Open your team -> saved My Home board and real task/calendar widgets successfully.
